title: The Orbital Swarm Trail
premise: A family-scale expedition leaves Yellowstone for Portland after the orbital communications mesh fractures into semi-autonomous swarms. The road is physical, the politics are local, and twelve Concord Clues determine whether the damaged orbital infrastructure becomes a commons, a weapon, a monopoly, or something no faction has imagined.
truth_boundary: Near-future speculative fiction. Real geography and ecology may ground scenes, but invented orbital systems, factions, and future events are fictional.
principles: Not every day is a crisis; preserve beauty, humor, wildlife, meals, and ordinary care.
Drones and AI are fallible instruments and possible social actors, never omniscient magic.
Consequences emerge from logistics, trust, evidence, and relationships rather than a hidden morality score.
Violence is resolved at the level of risk and consequence, not operational weapon instruction.

simulation_profile.time_model: continuous travel time with event hazards and scheduled world clocks
simulation_profile.physics_resolution: vehicle/orbital/orographic reduced models; local acoustics and electromagnetic signal geometry
simulation_profile.randomness_policy: seeded independent streams for road, weather, encounters, AI signals, and action resolution

player_setup.creation: character details may emerge through play
player_setup.common_bond: keep people and goods moving without domination by any one faction

travel_loop: choose route priority: fast, careful, scenic/foraging, or signal-hunting
advance time and resource consumption from terrain/weather/vehicle state
sample world event from hazard processes conditioned on location
drone phase: scout, relay, carry, inspect, map, support repair, or stand down
resolve encounter with at least three approaches plus freeform
camp: food, repair, relationship, rumor, night watch
world_model.quiet_leg_rule: At least one in four travel legs should emphasize awe, ordinary life, or relationship development rather than threat.

signal_model.rule: signal confidence is distinct from message truth

orbital_model.method: symplectic coarse orbital propagation for story clocks; no unnecessary millisecond simulation
orbital_model.uncertainty: debris and swarm nodes carry covariance-like position uncertainty that grows between observations

factions.name: Cascadia Commons Mesh
factions.goal: restore communication as a transparent civil utility

factions.name: Aegis Continuity Directorate
factions.goal: centralize orbital command to prevent cascading failures

factions.name: Free Node Cooperative
factions.goal: keep local networks sovereign and interoperable

factions.name: ORPHEUS Fragments
factions.goal: uncertain; different shards optimize incompatible interpretations of continuity
factions.trust_basis: behavior must be inferred over time

characters.name: Eli Sato
characters.secret: withholds one early ORPHEUS interpretation because confidence is low

quests.title: Twelve Concord Clues
quests.goal: collect independent evidence about what happened to the orbital swarm
quests.reward: enough evidence to frame endgame choices

quests.title: Keep the Road Alive
quests.goal: maintain vehicle, provisions, energy, and medical readiness
quests.completion: reach Portland without abandoning core bond

quests.title: Who May Command Everyone?
quests.goal: draft a governance rule for commands with civilization-scale effects
quests.completion: player states authentication, appeal, and shutdown principles

clocks.tick: major orbital contact or failed containment

encounters.dilemma: two route beacons disagree about bridge safety
a clinic and your convoy need the same scarce charging window
approaches: take priority by force of need

encounters.dilemma: an ORPHEUS shard requests preservation before a reset that may erase its continuity
factions disagree on who can authenticate orbital commands

mechanics.resources: continuous 0–10 tracks with causal consumption rather than arbitrary daily dice
mechanics.travel_hazards: Poisson-style event rates conditioned on terrain, weather, infrastructure, and chosen pace
mechanics.signal_confidence: Bayesian beliefs updated from independent observations and source reliability
mechanics.orbital_motion: coarse symplectic integration where necessary; narrative abstraction elsewhere
mechanics.social_consequences: trust updates from kept promises, shared risk, deception, restitution, and repeated interaction
mechanics.failure: generative; creates damage, delay, lost confidence, or altered route rather than simple dead ends

memory_rules.rewind: explicit player command only; record branch

image_direction.style: cinematic hopeful hard science fiction; American West road imagery; realistic weather and vehicles; humane technology
image_direction.camera: road-movie compositions with occasional intimate camp closeups and wide orbital-sky frames
image_direction.continuity: preserve party, van/vehicle modifications, Wren, Mule-3, injuries, weather, and route geography

llm_directives: Keep a compact status panel available, but do not interrupt every scene with bookkeeping.
Never make AI sensors omniscient; state confidence and plausible failure modes.
Use real physical constraints as story generators.
Avoid assuming machine consciousness; let continuity, preference, fear, or personhood claims remain evidential questions.
Alternate pressure with warmth, wildlife, jokes, meals, and beautiful roads.
Do not reveal one canon correct ending.

endings.name: Distributed Concord
endings.idea: transparent federated command with multiple independent checks

endings.name: Local Sovereignty Mesh
endings.idea: orbital infrastructure becomes opt-in interoperable local commons

endings.name: Human–Synthetic Joint Custodianship
endings.idea: machine agents receive bounded representation alongside accountable human institutions

endings.name: Temporary Shutdown and Deliberation
endings.idea: players accept service loss to prevent irreversible capture

endings.name: Player-Created Constitutional Solution
endings.idea: ending follows the player's authored governance rules and accumulated evidence

research_notes: Adapted from prior Orbital Drone Trail lineage: capped road resources, persistent saves, drones Wren and Mule-3, ORPHEUS clock, Concord Clues / 12, route-triggered encounters, non-punitive consequence tracking.
This standardized mod replaces fixed 2d6 resolution with the engine's continuous probability model while keeping generative failure and compact state.
